field_principles.checkpoint_path: the models/arc_verifier_<game>.json path (mirror-ready per decentralization Rule 3).
field_principles.duration_s: the measured wall-clock; must be consistent with inference_substrate (>=1s for verifier-ensemble, >=60s for live_llm_inference).
field_principles.flag_resolved: true iff the fresh artifact is NOT flagged true_live_recheck=critical (the substrate declaration holds).
field_principles.honest_verdict: terminal prefix; refreshed + gate green is success_self_play_checkpoint_refreshed.
field_principles.inference_substrate: the HONEST substrate -- verifier_ensemble_against_cached_candidates (1s floor) for an offline gate run; live_llm_inference (60s floor) ONLY if the generator ran >=60s. This MAINTAINS the .456 exp4949 substrate fix.
field_principles.offline_reproduced: reproduction gate must pass on >=1 level for the checkpoint to be a real self-play artifact.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: records arcade/registry/checkpoint checks; a missing target emits blocked_, never a fabricated checkpoint.
field_principles.solve_provenance: live_agent_self_discovery -- self-play is the agent improving on its own attempts.
field_principles.target_game: the rotated self-play target (differs from .459 ft09 / .458 sp80 / .457 dc22 / .456 lp85 / .455 ar25 / .453 bp35 / .452 vc33 / .451 sk48 / .450 ls20 / .449 re86 AND from A1/A2).
field_principles.verifier_checkpoint_refreshed: the self-improvement signal -- the learned verifier trained on this run's traces (FR-11).
